This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the time phrase is redundant because 古代 already names a time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到很多人正在吃一些植物，the intended meaning is that 神农 perceived the people; 看 means “look,” while 看到 marks the result of seeing. [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，别人 means other people contrasted with a stated person or group, while this sentence refers to people generally. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一天，神农：一天，他，use a pronoun when the character was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other character competes as the referent. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed.
看到 correctly expresses the completed perception, unlike bare 看 in this context.
别人 incorrectly contrasts the people with someone else, whereas 人们 can refer to the group of people here.
The recent mention of 神农 should be followed by 他, but the displayed fragment lacks a predicate.
